what_it_does: This paper evaluates the reproducibility of research that tested four different number formats (ways to represent floating-point numbers in hardware) on a specific mathematical algorithm called the Implicitly Restarted Arnoldi Method. The formats tested were standard floating-point (OFP8), Google's bfloat16, Posit (an alternative compact format), and Takum (another novel format). The paper verifies whether the original research results can be obtained independently.
